positionRuns.detectionRule: Three consecutive selections at the same position; a five-pick rolling window establishes the run and overlapping windows are merged into one maximal episode.
positionRuns.interpretation: The six-pick WR run is evaluated as evidence; consecutive selections alone do not establish panic, causation, or a grade penalty.

tierRuns.reason: The registered market source provides no supported tiers and is not draft-cutoff valid.

gradingArchitecture.immediateImpactTreatment: Display separately from long-term dynasty outlook; do not combine until cutoff-safe role evidence exists.
gradingArchitecture.falsePrecisionTreatment: Use integer component grades or letter bands only after evidence coverage is approved; never publish unsupported decimal precision.

sourceGaps: RotoBaller and Sports Illustrated are dynasty boards without an explicit 1QB label; both are retained with accurate roles rather than falsely labeled 1QB.
Late-round source disagreement and single-source coverage remain uncertainty, especially for fourth-round selections.
No trustworthy cutoff-safe pre-draft roster boundary exists; roster fit is permanently excluded from the formal 2026 class grade.
August Fantasy Orphans market remains a separate since-draft lens.

marketAtDraft.medianConvention: marketMedianRank is the median of captured eligible provider ranks; omitted rows are not imputed.
marketAtDraft.marketDifferenceConvention: actualOverallPick - marketMedianRank; positive is VALUE and negative is REACH

currentMarketReference.reason: The only registered market snapshot is post-draft/preseason and cannot judge what was knowable at the draft cutoff.

transactionCoverage.reason: The retrieved feed begins after the season baseline boundary cannot be established; no complete offseason feed can be proven.

reconstructionAudit.forwardTarget: No trustworthy timestamped immediate post-draft roster snapshot is available

rosterFitExclusionReason: No trustworthy cutoff-safe May 29 pre-draft roster boundary or complete offseason transaction history exists; roster fit is excluded from the formal 2026 class grade.

marketThresholds.wideDispersionRule: A wide provider range suppresses a strong label unless the round threshold is exceeded.

finalMarketBoard.consensus: Median of eligible cutoff-safe player-ranking sources.

methodology: This is a one-time retrospective asking how the 48 selections look using the dynasty market as of the evaluation date. It is not a May 29 draft-day grading exercise. Beginning in 2027, repeat this analysis approximately one week after the LCC draft.

confidence.LOW: 0.35 influence and cannot create strong grade signal alone
confidence.UNRANKED: excluded from market delta and cannot receive an automatic penalty

capitalAdjustment.purpose: premium picks matter more; late-round deltas cannot dominate
capitalAdjustment.falsePrecision: diagnostic weighting only; no public decimals

doubleCountingControls: opportunity cost is reported separately and penalizes only better-ranked available alternatives
roster fit and historical tendencies are excluded from numeric score
NFL capital is not re-added as current market rank
gradeMethodology.draftGrade: quality of capital use, normalized for pick value and evidence confidence
gradeMethodology.classImpact: total supported dynasty value and meaningful assets added; quantity informs impact, not efficiency
gradeMethodology.gradeScale: league-relative with absolute guardrails; median should normally land B-/C+
gradeMethodology.aPlus: reserved for top-tail efficiency plus multiple high-confidence signals
gradeMethodology.dF: requires repeated supported negative evidence; uncertainty alone cannot produce D/F
gradeMethodology.awards: candidate lists may be withheld; no forced WTF winner

roastConfidence.STRONG_ROAST: high-confidence major reach, huge opportunity cost, repeated supported bad value, or supported run-induced reach

gradeMethodology.rosterContext: CURRENT_CONTEXT_ONLY; never presented as historical May need
removedOrReduced: ROSTER_FIT reduced to narrative-only because May need is unavailable
DYNASTY_UPSIDE reduced to 10% to avoid reusing current market rank
commonSenseControls: pick quantity does not set Draft Grade

normalizedBoard.reason: All captured rows are eligible rookie-market candidates; undrafted eligible rookies remain in the comparison universe.

sourceDisagreement.meaning: spread of 8 or more rank slots reduces confidence and should not support a strong grade signal alone

scaleDecision.reason: The two providers do not expose identical row universes. No player is defensibly excluded, so the normalized board uses the union of both current 1QB rookie lists, orders by mean available source rank, preserves every eligible undrafted rookie, and retains raw N2.3 ranks for sensitivity.
scaleDecision.retrospectiveLabel: CURRENT_MARKET_RETROSPECTIVE; hindsight relative to August market, not May draft-day quality
